content.section_14.6_title: Patient-reported outcome measures and patient-reported experience measures
content.section_14.6_summary: Understanding and measuring patient expectations and health outcomes using PROMs and PREMs is central to improving patient satisfaction and delivering patient-centred care. The quality of care for ACS patients should be measured during the patient's journey from initial presentation until discharge. Further information can be found in the Supplementary data online.
